thesis: The podcast argues that the prevailing narrative of a 'SaaS-pocalypse' is premature and not supported by actual business spending data from 50,000 companies. While new AI companies are emerging and some vendors are beginning to offer token-based pricing, the majority of spend remains on traditional seat-based contracts, and traditional SaaS incumbents like Figma continue to grow rather than collapse.
